introduction: What is it like to experience the incredible journey that takes place during the baby’s 1st year? The baby himself tells you his story and shares his emotions, excitement and surprises that emerge from the daily life of a real family. Through rigorous scientific investigations, we will discover what takes place during the development of an infant.
